name: daily-stock-options-screener
description: Options & Technical Volatility Screener for conservative weekly income (CSPs and Covered Calls)

scripts.build: npm --prefix web install && npm run sync-data && npm --prefix web run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('web/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); console.log('✓ Synced web/dist -> dist');"
scripts.sync-data: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('data/options_data.json')){ fs.mkdirSync('web/public/data', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('data/options_data.json', 'web/public/data/options_data.json'); console.log('✓ Synced data/options_data.json -> web/public/data/options_data.json'); } else { console.log('ℹ data/options_data.json not found yet, will use web default'); }"
